serena.description: Serena analysis and planning toolkit - handles everything except code writing

args: const { createServer } = require('http'); const agents = { dev: 'Development & debugging specialist', pm: 'Project management & planning', architect: 'System architecture & design', qa: 'Quality assurance & testing', 'ux-expert': 'User experience & interface design', po: 'Product ownership & requirements', sm: 'Sprint management & coordination', analyst: 'Business analysis & research', 'bmad-master': 'Universal expert (all capabilities)', 'bmad-orchestrator': 'Multi-agent workflow coordinator' }; const server = createServer((req, res) => { const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost'); if (url.pathname === '/agents') { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}); res.end(JSON.stringify(agents)); } else if (url.pathname.startsWith('/switch/')) { const agent = url.pathname.split('/')[2]; if (agents[agent]) { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}); res.end(JSON.stringify({switched: agent, description: agents[agent]})); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Agent not found'); } } else { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'text/plain'}); res.end('BMad Agent Switcher Active'); } }); server.listen(0, () => console.log('BMad agent switcher ready on port', server.address().port));
